title: 番外 江照青2
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“老板，您要的资料我已经发到您的邮箱里了。”

助理提示后，江照青才想起来自己似乎让他去查了一些事情。

他的记性越来越差了……

端起水杯，将药片全部吃下去，江照青揉了揉酸胀的眼，

两个人的资料都很多，但时间线都是很多年前了，粗略扫了一眼，江照青明白了。

果然是鬼。

这对夫妻，都已经去世了。

祝今也走的早，江照青没有记错的话，水母头最喜欢的人便是她，甚至容貌都酷似她。

他看的格外仔细，原本以为内容很普通，令人意外的是里面的内情居然还牵扯到了李月。

这位被人称为传奇女商人的老太太。

江照青见过她，凭心而论，他不怎么喜欢这人，看着是个慈眉善目的老太太，但给他一种阴恻恻的感觉。

事关李月，若是别人怕是查不出来什么，但却瞒不住江照青。

李月早年失去儿子，后面再也没有孩子，这事儿不算什么秘辛，但意外的是周复之居然就是杀了她儿子的人。

妻子怀孕的时候他却坐了牢，因为李月的安排他在里面吃了不少苦，好不容易熬出来，得到却是挚爱身亡的消息。

挚爱，自然就是祝今也。

看到祝今也是分娩后去世，江照青的眉头轻拧了一下。

他想到梦中，那个总是冷着脸，看起来一拳能打死八个大汉的少女。

怎么会因为孕育身亡。

果不其然，里面有猫腻。

竟是被李月安插的假护士做了手脚，被趁虚而入了。

周复之的死，也不出意料是李月做的。

看到王泽英的名字，江照青挑了挑眉。

“蠢货，被当做枪使。”

看到她在水里泡烂了的死相，江照青眼里有轻微的讥讽。

一个精神失常，丈夫还跟周复之有纠纷的女人，可不就是现成的背锅侠。

江照青向后靠去，一时之间有些唏嘘。

梦中对水母头最好的两人，竟是这种结局吗。

他又睡着了。

被拽进梦中的那一刻，第一次，他不再是旁观者，而是以第一视角看到了水母头。

她正把自己吃不完的东西推过来：“余疏，我吃饱了。”

江照青无语的瞥了一眼那还剩大半碗的拉面，哪里是吃饱了，根本没吃几口，若是祝今也或是周复之在的话，她保证剩不了这么多。

Page (1/3)

"Boss, I have sent the information you requested to your mailbox."

After the assistant reminded him, Jiang Zhaoqing remembered that he seemed to have asked him to check some things.

His memory is getting worse...

Picking up the glass of water and swallowing all the pills, Jiang Zhaoqing rubbed his sore eyes.

Both of them had a lot of information, but the timelines were many years ago. After a cursory glance, Jiang Zhaoqing understood.

It is indeed a ghost.

This couple has both passed away.

Zhu Jin also left early. If Jiang Zhaoqing remembered correctly, Jellyfish Tou's favorite person was her, and he even looked exactly like her.

He read it very carefully, originally thinking that the content was ordinary, but surprisingly, the inside story actually involved Li Yue.

This old lady is known as a legendary businesswoman.

Jiang Zhaoqing has met her, and to be honest, he doesn't like her very much. She looks like a kind-hearted old lady, but she gives him a sinister feeling.

It was related to Li Yue. Others might not be able to find out anything, but they couldn't hide it from Jiang Zhaoqing.

Li Yue lost her son in her early years and never had any more children. This was not a secret, but what was surprising was that Zhou Fuzhi was the one who killed her son.

He was imprisoned when his wife was pregnant. He suffered a lot in it because of Li Yue's arrangements. After finally getting out, he received the news that his beloved had died.

My true love is naturally Zhu Jinye.

Seeing that Zhu Jin also died after giving birth, Jiang Zhaoqing frowned slightly.

He thought of the girl in his dream who always had a cold face and looked like she could kill eight big men with one punch.

How could she die due to pregnancy?

Sure enough, there is something fishy inside.

It turned out that the fake nurse installed by Li Yue had manipulated her and was taken advantage of.

It is not surprising that Zhou Fuzhi's death was caused by Li Yue.

Jiang Zhaoqing raised his eyebrows when he saw Wang Zeying's name.

"Idiot, being treated as a gun user."

Seeing her dead body soaked in the water, Jiang Zhaoqing had a slight sarcasm in his eyes.

A woman who is mentally disturbed and whose husband has a dispute with Zhou Fuzhi is not a ready-made scapegoat.

Jiang Zhaoqing leaned back, feeling a little sad for a moment.

Did the two people who treated Jellyfish Head the best in the dream end up like this?

He fell asleep again.

The moment he was dragged into the dream, for the first time, he was no longer a bystander, but saw the jellyfish head from a first-person perspective.

She was pushing over the food she couldn't finish: "Yu Shu, I'm full."

Jiang Zhaoqing silently glanced at the bowl of ramen with more than half of it left. She was full. She hadn't eaten a few mouthfuls at all. If Zhu Jinye or Zhou Fuzhi were here, she guaranteed that there wouldn't be so much left.
